verdicts.explanation: The paper states Zn(TFSI)2·3SN reached 0.62 mS cm⁻¹ at 25 °C, citing ref. [84]. Material, value, unit, temperature and literature origin all match.
The paper states the ZnPS3 solid-state electrolyte reached 2 mS cm⁻¹ at 30 °C (ref. [55]). The 0.3 eV value is a calculated diffusion barrier and is correctly left out of activation_energy_eV.
The paper states ZnZr4(PO4)6 exhibited 0.00134 mS cm⁻¹ at 500 °C (ref. [15]). The record correctly takes the lowest-temperature value.
The paper states the crystallized eutectic Zn conductor (ZCE) gave 0.0378 mS cm⁻¹ at 30 °C with transference number 0.64 (ref. [60]). Material, value, temperature and origin match.
The paper gives 0.313 mS cm⁻¹ and 0.12 eV for the deep-eutectic-in-PCN-222 system (ref. [116]) with no measurement temperature, so null temperature is correct.
